title: 34th sitting of the 20th Majlis
summary: A short 37-minute sitting (09:00 to 09:37). The Speaker's table sent three minister nominations to the Government Oversight committee, the nominee for Ambassador to India and the IAEA membership request to the Foreign Relations committee, and the Elections Commission nominee to the Independent Institutions committee. Three government bills (GST, airport passenger fee, tourism) were read for the first time. Three Finance Committee audit/assessment reports were briefly debated by three members and each passed in an open vote with no votes against.

speakers.name: Qasim Ibrahim
positions: Presented the three Finance Committee reports and asked members to decide on them.
Said the committee and its sub-committee reviewed the audit reports and the council building assessment.
On the council building contract, said the committee found it was cancelled and the money owed should be recovered.

speakers.name: Dr. Anara Naeem
positions: Thanked the committee, said systems exist but oversight and enforcement should be strengthened, and called for tighter financial controls.

speakers.name: Husnee Mubarik
positions: Questioned the council building contract signed during the transition period, said the government supports councils, and said merit-based hiring should be required.
